description: The rule that gives the editor page a real height: body pinned to the web view with position:fixed and all four offsets. src/styles/base.css owns it for the app; editor.html repeats it UNLAYERED because a Chromium 80-98 Android System WebView discards every @layer'd rule and would otherwise leave body static and zero-height, collapsing the whole #editor -> .futo-milkdown -> .ProseMirror height chain (github#33). Same declarations on purpose - change one, change the other.
